addendumScenarios.acceptance: Import, edit both the source and local copy, then re-import. The user can inspect the differences and choose a resolution without losing either retained version.

Exercise source-only, local-only, converged, null-versus-missing, moved, deleted and denied-source cases through ZIP and the applicable HTML/API paths. Results conform to D002 and the source's actual completeness.
Interrupt capture/application, retry and submit a stale resolution. No duplicate canonical object or attachment is created, and newer local edits survive.
Edit title, status and due date from a page occurrence, Tasks/Home and a database. Every surface agrees after restart and native restore.
Promote an existing record, create multiple occurrences, remove one and trash/restore the record. IDs remain stable and no task is silently duplicated or deleted.
Retry extraction/import of an identified task. The existing task is reused or ambiguity is reviewed; equal titles alone do not establish identity.
Restore an encrypted archive on an independent clean installation and compare canonical content, schema, relationships, assets and retained history, not just counts.

Wrong passphrase, tampering, truncation, low disk, cancellation and crash cannot activate a partial destination. Temporary plaintext is handled under a documented cleanup/recovery policy without promising forensic secure erasure.
Existing native archives remain readable, encryption status is visible before export, and no credential or passphrase appears in inspected logs or archive metadata.
Each release claim resolves to a named profile, exact candidate and independent pass condition with actual results and limitations.
Answerable, ambiguous and unanswerable queries plus clean/noisy representative audio are evaluated with frozen expected outcomes and manual review where required.
New rubrics and performance policies are versioned before execution; frozen candidate-7 evidence is neither rewritten nor used to qualify a changed product.
Start/pause/resume/stop a real authorized recording, deny permission and disconnect an input. Indicators and saved audio accurately reflect what occurred.
Interrupt a recording/transcription and simulate low disk. Retained audio is recoverable, gaps/errors are visible and retry does not duplicate transcripts or actions.
Correct a transcript, navigate its evidence, review resulting actions and apply retention choices. Stale derived information is marked or excluded and unrelated source content remains intact.
A configured reminder is submitted through the real OS path with the main app closed; denial and disabled-background behavior are visible in settings/inbox.
Snooze, dismiss, complete, edit and cancel across sleep, restart, timezone/DST changes and concurrent schedule publication. No duplicate canonical effect or unreported stale registration occurs.
Restore a workspace and disable/re-enable the background component. Old epochs cannot reactivate unexpectedly, and uncertain OS outcomes remain explicitly uncertain.
Run a meeting-follow-up or project-review skill on selected sources, inspect evidence and approve selected changes. Unselected pages and disallowed tools remain unavailable.
Edit the skill version, cancel/retry a run and change provider explicitly. History identifies each version/provider and prior writes are not duplicated.
Import a skill containing instructions to grant access or execute arbitrary code. It remains inert and cannot bypass the ordinary permission layer.
Fill selected empty fields while leaving other records, existing manual values and computed fields unchanged. Invalid or unsupported values remain reviewable failures.
Edit a row or schema during generation and then apply. Newer values survive; stale suggestions cannot overwrite them.
Interrupt/resume and repeat an applied batch, then undo. Effects are not duplicated, provenance remains inspectable and unrelated edits are preserved.
Review a page, edit its covered content and pass its review deadline. Status and queue update accurately without altering the underlying knowledge.
Search/cite reviewed and stale pages. Freshness is visible and never presented as machine-verified truth or used to override current contradictory evidence.
Restore an earlier page/workspace revision. Review history remains attributable, elapsed deadlines are honored and stale approved memory remains excluded.
Reuse a layout across records, rename a property, create an override and reset it. Values and stable references survive restart, undo and restore.
Remove/change a schema property and open older records. The UI reports or safely omits invalid layout references without losing retained data.
Move a predecessor in a chain and a branched graph. Preview every affected date before writing; cancellation changes nothing and grouped undo restores the applied batch.
Exercise cycle, missing date, weekend/DST and concurrent-edit cases. The declared calendar/constraint policy determines the result; stale or invalid plans cannot partly apply.

Record the audience/workflow findings, accepted next scope and unresolved limitations in `PROGRESS.md`. Until a mobile scope decision changes, release messaging shall state the tested desktop/platform boundary. This is decision acceptance, not a mobile implementation pass.

Use a real authorized account/server to select a bounded source set, refresh/search/preview supported content and disconnect. Unselected resources are unavailable and cached results disclose freshness.
Switch accounts, revoke access, interrupt pagination, rotate credentials and hit rate limits. Resume cannot widen scope or mistake denied/partial data for deletion.
Preview and execute a permitted write, then exercise stale remote state and timeout-after-send. The receipt records the actual or unknown outcome; reconciliation prevents duplicate effects.
Restore/import connector state and attempt AI retrieval. No credential, activation, ambient context grant or pending external write is silently restored.
